country.evidence_quote: Initially serving sheet metal fabrication companies and OEM manufacturers throughout the southern United States, Assembly Fasteners built its reputation on dependable supply, responsive service, and a commitment to helping customers solve sourcing challenges.

contact.name: Hugh Watson
